provenance.notes: Synthetic names composed by the researcher from common given and family names; not records of real people. The expected values are computed: lengths and grapheme clusters by ICU (Intl.Segmenter), directions from UCD bidi classes, search keys by a re-implementation of the owner's arabic.search.v1 normalisation (lib/contracts.mjs). The choice and spelling of the names is from model knowledge and needs a native reviewer.

data.purpose: Arabic personal names that stress an interface: compound names written joined and apart, particles, very long full names, vocalised names, spelling variants of one name, mixed Arabic and Latin, initials and honorific prefixes. Use it for truncation and wrapping, avatar initials, direction of free text, sorting, search and duplicate warnings. Every name must be stored and displayed exactly as typed.

cases.note: عُمَر and عَمْرو are different names; without marks and the final waw «عمر» is ambiguous.
Alef + combining madda (U+0627 U+0653): canonically equal to U+0622.
A third spelling that no tolerance level of arabic.search.v1 folds.
Typed «على» by writers who do not dot the final yaa; «على» is also the preposition.
Final U+06CC FARSI YEH from a Persian or Urdu keyboard: looks like «على» in final position.
Persian name with U+067E and U+06CC.
Persian compound name written with U+200C ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER.
Name pasted with a trailing U+200F.

data.expectedShape: { codePoints, utf16Length, graphemes (extended grapheme clusters), firstStrongDirection (what dir="auto" gives), dominantDirection (the owner's words-vote rule; differs from first-strong for Latin-first Arabic names), searchKeys: the comparison key at each tolerance level of arabic.search.v1 — two names with the same duplicateCheck key must raise a similar-record warning and are never merged }. No expected value for how a name is split into parts: that is not decidable from the string.
